capabilities: Sync the vault with an mdbase collection
Design note types in a form or in YAML
Create notes from a type with a property form
Link to or create typed notes by typing @
Validate notes against their types with one-click fixes
disambiguation: Not a database or query tool; it syncs the vault with mdbase and checks notes against note types.
extras: Sync is unavailable on iPhone and iPad; Android sync has only been tested on an emulator. New versions ship as prereleases first. Types and validation work offline without an account. Plugin-to-plugin integrations are off by default, and the plugin collects no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep a vault in step with mdbase apps, or to define and enforce which properties a kind of note must have.

relations.evidence: Sync your vault across devices and use it in mdbase apps like TaskNotes.
it can sync the vault instead, in the background, even when Obsidian is closed
install the BRAT plugin, choose Add beta plugin, and enter mdbase-dev/mdbase-obsidian

summary: Syncs a vault with mdbase collections across devices and adds typed notes, with validation and @-linking by type.
